name: leia-organa
reference_text: General Kenobi, years ago you served my father in the Clone Wars. Now he begs you to help him and his struggle against the Empire. I regret that I am unable to present my father's request to you in person, but my ship has fallen under attack, and I'm afraid my mission to bring you to Obi-Wan has failed.
